Monday – Friday: 9:30 AM – 7:00 PM
Practice Area
Title diligence, transfers and possession disputes resolved cleanly.
Overview
We handle title verification, sale and transfer documentation, mutation and registration, partition of joint family property, and disputes over possession, easements and encroachment.
Most property litigation traces back to a document that was signed without diligence. We would rather spend a week verifying a title chain than three years litigating it, and we say so plainly when a proposed transaction should not proceed on the papers available.
Services Offered
Title search, verification and legal opinion
Sale deeds, gift deeds, lease deeds and agreements to sell
Registration, stamp duty advisory and mutation
Partition suits and family property division
Possession, encroachment and easement disputes
Landlord and tenant disputes and eviction proceedings
Our Process
Four stages, each with a defined output — so you always know what has happened and what comes next.
We examine the title chain, revenue records and encumbrances, and issue a written opinion identifying every defect we find.
We distinguish defects that can be cured from those that cannot, so you can decide whether to proceed, renegotiate or walk away.
We draft and register the operative documents, advise on stamp duty, and complete mutation in the revenue records.
Where a dispute already exists, we pursue injunction, declaration or possession relief, or negotiate a documented settlement.
Benefits
These are commitments, not aspirations. If we fail one of them on your matter, tell the partner handling it.
Written title opinions that state risk plainly
Stamp duty and registration handled end to end
Clear advice on when not to buy
Revenue record follow-through after registration
Related
Get In Touch
Tell us about your matter and we will respond within one working day. Every enquiry is confidential from the moment it reaches us.
Messages answered during office hours.
